task: Bionic implementation step 1: minimal viable verification. Take an arm64 AOSP14 Bionic linker64+libc, point a minimal native program's PT_INTERP at it, exec on a stock OH 6.1 board, confirm zero avc and that the pthread_internal_t/TLS layout is Bionic's. If it holds, emit the 57-library rebuild batch plan.
mode: read-only research + minimal on-board exec; only /data/local/tmp/bionic39 written; no /system, no remount, no reflash; no app launched

part1_provenance.extraction_path: system.img (GPT) -> super (liblp logical partition 'system', ext4) -> /system/apex/com.android.runtime.apex (zip) -> apex_payload.img (ext4) -> debugfs rdump (read-only)
part1_provenance.note: AOSP14 arm64 matches Toutiao metasec's target ABI (arm64, Android 14/15 Bionic). Extraction was fully read-only from the official Google image; nothing was rebuilt or patched.

A_static_control.reason: NDK r23b emits TLS segment alignment 8; AOSP14 Bionic requires >=64 on arm64 (SIGABRT before main). Toolchain nuance, NOT a linker-path failure. Confirms the shipped libc IS genuine AOSP14 Bionic (it enforces the newer alignment rule).

B_hello_dyn_via_linker64.warning: linker: failed to find /linkerconfig/ld.config.txt (benign fallback to default namespace honoring LD_LIBRARY_PATH)

B2_explicit_linker_absolute_path.note: linker64 executable-mode requires an absolute program path ('expected absolute path' when given ./relative)

avc.method: dmesg diff from baseline line 2081 + hilog -x grep; no dmesg -c used

art_special.constraint: must match the Android boot image (boot .art/.oat) it loads; cannot be a free rebuild

part3_batch_plan.effort_heuristic: 1 pd base per lib + 0.05 pd per C-API forwarder symbol + 0.15 pd per C++ innerkit symbol (vtable/RTTI/ABI bridge). C-API/innerkit split is name-based (GLES/EGL/vulkan/native_*/hilog/hitrace/napi/_ndk/begetutil/sync_fence => C-API; ipc/utils/want/ability/window/render_service/dm/mmi/... => C++ innerkit); libsurface is counted C-API because it exposes a C native_window ABI.
